subject: general
question: Who is the Governor of the Reserve Bank of India as of May 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sanjay Malhotra**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Sanjay Malhotra (born 14 February 1968) is an Indian bureaucrat and IAS officer who is serving as the current and 26th Governor of the Reserve Bank of India since 11 December 2024.
 
• He is an IAS Officer of the 1990 Batch Rajasthan Cadre, and has served in various positions throughout his career.
 
• In February 2022, he was appointed Secretary of Financial Services in the Ministry of Finance and during his time in the position, he launched the initial public offering of the Life Insurance Corporation and was also a member of the board of the Reserve Bank of India (RBI).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sanjay Malhotra:**

 
 
• Shaktikanta Das has served as the Governor of the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) since December 12, 2018.
 
• He is a retired Indian Administrative Service (IAS) officer of the 1980 batch from the Tamil Nadu cadre.
 
• Shaktikanta Das has played a pivotal role in steering India’s monetary policy and ensuring financial stability in the country.
 
• He has previously served as the Secretary of the Department of Economic Affairs, where he was instrumental in implementing key economic reforms such as the Goods and Services Tax (GST).
 
• Under his leadership, RBI has adopted policies focused on inflation targeting, digital banking expansion, and ensuring adequate liquidity in the financial system.
 
• He was reappointed for a second term, reflecting the confidence of policymakers in his leadership and contributions to the Indian economy.
 
 
 
• **Raghuram Rajan:**
 
 
• Raghuram Rajan served as the 23rd Governor of the Reserve Bank of India from September 2013 to September 2016.
 
• He is a renowned economist and former Chief Economist at the International Monetary Fund (IMF).
 
• Rajan is well-known for his warnings about the 2008 financial crisis and his contributions to India's banking reforms during his tenure.
 
• He is currently a professor at the University of Chicago Booth School of Business.
 
 
 
• **Urjit Patel:**
 
 
• Urjit Patel served as the 24th Governor of the Reserve Bank of India from September 2016 to December 2018.
 
• He succeeded Raghuram Rajan and was known for his emphasis on inflation targeting and monetary policy reforms.
 
• Patel resigned from his post citing personal reasons, and his tenure was marked by significant challenges, including demonetization and liquidity management.
 
 
 
• **Reserve Bank of India (RBI):**
 
 
• The RBI is the central bank of India, established on April 1, 1935, under the Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934.
 
• It regulates the issuance and supply of the Indian rupee and ensures the stability of the financial system.
 
• The RBI is responsible for monetary policy formulation, foreign exchange management, and oversight of banking operations in India.
 
• The Governor of the RBI is the chief executive of the central bank and plays a key role in shaping economic policies.
